summary: Compact non-interactive informational copy row for settings cards.
useWhen: A settings card needs persistent informational copy above its content.
The message should remain visible in both read-only and editing presentations of the settings card.
The message needs body-medium typography, compact spacing, and a single tertiary bottom boundary.
avoidWhen: The message belongs in general bounded content outside a settings card; reserve the general inline-banner component for that use case.
The message is application-wide or needs dismissal, actions, or announcement urgency; use Banner.
The message is transient or follows a completed action; use Toast.

alternatives.when: A persistent application-wide condition needs optional actions or dismissal.
alternatives.reason: Banner owns shell-level messaging, actions, dismissal, and announcement behavior.

alternatives.when: A field needs supporting or validation copy tied to its control.
alternatives.reason: Field owns the control relationship and supporting-message semantics.

accessibility: Keep the description concise and authored; InlineBannerSettings does not transform, truncate, or announce the copy.
Use InlineBannerSettings for static context. Applications must choose a live-region component when a dynamic announcement is required.
The informational copy remains plain text and has no interactive controls or dismissal affordance.
states: The description renders verbatim in every state in which the owning settings card projects the component.
The component has no internal visibility, editing, or dismissal state; the owning settings card controls whether it is present.
The content height is intrinsic: the banner contributes 8px block padding and its inner content container contributes 6px block padding, followed by the tertiary bottom boundary.
responsiveBehavior: The component fills the available inline size and lets body-medium copy wrap naturally.
The effective inline inset remains 16px: 8px banner padding, 6px inner content padding, and 2px text-side padding.

customElements: Pass the complete authored message through description; do not apply a CSS casing transform or mutate the text for presentation.
react: Pass the complete authored message through the description prop and keep the component mounted for every settings-card state that needs the context.
angular: Bind [description] from the settings card's stable copy source and project the component outside any edit-only conditional.

styling.rationale: The component owns only the compact settings informational row recipe; its card owns the surrounding surface and layout.

protected.reason: The component owns the readable informational row treatment and keeps its spacing consistent across settings cards.
